scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus walks along a sunlit stone street and looks toward a man seated beside a wall, his eyes closed and a walking stick resting across his lap.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 9:1, in which Jesus sees a man blind from birth while passing by. The setting, appearance, and walking stick are artistic choices. The English word glosses come from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: On a sunlit stone street, several disciples gesture as they question Jesus, while a seated man holds a walking staff beside them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the disciples asking Jesus whether the man born blind or his parents sinned. It depicts their question without presenting an answer, following the supplied Berean Interlinear word glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures while seated beside a man in a green scarf, as three listeners gather on sunlit stone steps in a village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This scene imaginatively portrays Jesus' answer in John 9:3: neither the man nor his parents sinned, and the works of God should be revealed in him. The setting, listeners, gestures and sunlight are artistic choices, not details specified in the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus and three companions draw water together at a stone village well in the golden light of a setting sun.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imagined scene of people working at a village well illustrates Jesus' words about doing the works of the One who sent him while it is day, before night comes. The verse does not describe this particular act.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A watercolor scene of Jesus standing with open arms among listeners on a hillside, with a sunlit valley and stone village beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering depicts Jesus among people, with light across the landscape suggesting his words that, while he is in the world, he is the light of the world.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed man gently applies brown clay to a seated man's closed eyes beside a stone wall, with damp earth on the ground nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene follows the excerpt's Berean Interlinear glosses for John 9:6: after speaking, he spat on the ground, made clay from the spittle, and applied it to the man's eyes. The setting and appearance of the people are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man with dripping hands walks up a sunlit stone path from a pool, looking around with wonder.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the man after he washed in the Pool of Siloam and began his return seeing, as described in John 9:7. His appearance and the setting are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man stands in a sunlit stone village lane as three neighbors look at him and gesture in conversation. A woven mat and a small bowl lie beside a doorway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 9:8, in which neighbors ask whether this is the man they had seen sitting and begging. The setting, mat, bowl, and gestures are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man in an ancient village gestures toward his chest as people around him point, smile, and look uncertain.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 9:9: people disagree about whether the man is the one they recognize or someone like him, while he says that he is the man. The setting, expressions, and gestures are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated man looks up at five surprised people gathered around him on a sunlit stone street. A woman points to her eyes while others gesture toward him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 9:10, in which people ask a man how his eyes were opened. The setting, appearance, and gestures are artistic choices. The supplied English token glosses come from the Berean Interlinear.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man kneels beside a sunlit stone pool with open eyes, water dripping from his hands and face as he looks upward in wonder.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the man at Siloam immediately after washing and receiving sight, one moment from the account he gives in John 9:11.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man in a sunlit stone village lane opens both hands in uncertainty while three nearby men question him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the question and the man’s reply that he does not know where the person is; the person being sought is not shown.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Several men bring a man with open eyes toward a group of Pharisees in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of people bringing the man who was formerly blind to the Pharisees in John 9:13; the setting, clothing and gestures are imagined. The English token glosses in the supplied excerpt come from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus holds a small lump of clay while a man with open eyes looks up at him in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the Sabbath day on which Jesus made clay and opened the man's eyes; the setting and poses are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a smiling man gestures toward his face as four robed men listen; a basin of water and a bowl of clay are nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative rendering of John 9:15: the Pharisees ask how the man received sight, and he recounts that clay was put on his eyes, he washed, and he can see. The courtyard, basin, and arrangement are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Robed men in a sunlit stone courtyard debate, some gesturing while others listen with questioning expressions.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imagined courtyard discussion expresses the division in John 9:16: some question the man's Sabbath observance while others ask how a sinful man could perform such signs. The setting, expressions, and gestures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated man with open eyes gestures as he speaks to four men gathered around him in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the exchange in John 9:17: the man whose eyes were opened answers those questioning him about the one who opened them, saying he is a prophet. The setting, clothing, and appearances are artistic choices. The verse relationship follows the excerpt's Berean Interlinear word glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A young man stands beside an older man and a woman in a sunlit stone courtyard, while a seated man gestures toward them and two others look on.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined courtyard scene evokes John 9:18, in which people who doubted that the man had been blind and had received sight call his parents. The setting, figures, and poses are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man gestures toward a couple as other men watch, while a young man nearby looks upward.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene inspired by John 9:19, in which questioners ask whether a man is the couple's son, whom they say was born blind, and how he now sees. The setting, appearances, and gestures are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A mother and father gesture toward their son while speaking in a sunny stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of John 9:20, in which the parents say they know he is their son and that he was born blind. The setting and appearances are imagined, and the image does not establish his present eyesight.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a woman and an older man gesture toward an adult man with open eyes as other people listen.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative interpretation of John 9:21: the speakers say they do not know how the man now sees or who opened his eyes, and direct others to ask him, since he is of age and will speak for himself. The setting and gestures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An anxious couple speaks with three men beside the open doorway of a sunlit stone building, while one man gestures outward.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evoking the parents' fear in John 9:22 and the agreed consequence of exclusion from the synagogue for anyone who confessed Him as Christ. The setting and interaction are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a mother and father gesture as they address robed listeners, while their adult son stands beside them with his hands clasped.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene illustrates John 9:23, where the parents say their son is of age and tell the listeners to ask him. The courtyard, gestures, and appearances are artistic inventions.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a seated man listens to three robed men, one raising a hand toward the sky as another gestures during the conversation.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene shows the man who had been blind after he is called back. The others urge him to give glory to God and call another man a sinner. The courtyard, clothing, and gestures are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man with bright, open eyes speaks with open hands to two listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard, with vines and an archway behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the speaker's answer in John 9:25: he does not know whether the other person is a sinner, but he knows that he was blind and now sees.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated man holds one hand near his eye while four robed men gesture toward him in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 9:26, in which people ask what was done to a man and how his eyes were opened. The setting and gestures are imagined. The supplied English token glosses come from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated man in a cream tunic gestures toward a group of listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imagined setting for the speaker's response in John 9:27: he says he already told them, asks why they want to hear again, and asks whether they also want to become his disciples.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, four robed men confront another man; one points at him while another gestures toward himself and holds a closed scroll.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene illustrates John 9:28, where a group rebukes a man and contrasts his discipleship with their claim to be disciples of Moses. The courtyard, gestures, and scroll are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a robed group discusses a blank parchment while one person gestures toward a man standing near an archway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects the speakers' statement that God has spoken to Moses and that they do not know where the man is from. The courtyard, parchment, and gestures are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures toward his face while speaking to three thoughtful listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard, painted in warm watercolor.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene represents the man's reply in John 9:30: he marvels that his listeners do not know where the one who opened his eyes is from. The setting and expressions are imaginative. The source excerpt's English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A kneeling man looks upward while pouring water into another man's bowl. Behind them, a merchant raises one hand while tending a balance at a fruit stall.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates John 9:31's contrast: God does not hear sinners, but hears the one who fears Him and does His will. The praying person sharing water is an artistic example; the verse does not describe these particular people or actions.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures toward his eyes and looks upward with wonder while four listeners gather around him in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 9:32's account of the unheard-of opening of the eyes of someone born blind. The courtyard, listeners, and their gestures are artistic additions.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man in cream robes helps a kneeling man to stand while a bearded speaker gestures and others watch.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses an act of help as a visual metaphor for John 9:33, which says that if this man were not from God, he could do nothing. The verse does not describe this particular action or setting. The English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed man with a walking stick looks back as he steps through a stone doorway into daylight, while several men inside gesture sternly after him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 9:34: a group rebukes a man, challenges him for teaching them, and casts him out. The setting, appearances, and gestures are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus leans toward a seated man beside a closed wooden door, gesturing as the man listens in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jesus finding the man after hearing that he was cast out and asking whether he believes in the Son of Man. The courtyard and poses are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated man gestures with open hands toward another man listening in a sunlit stone courtyard, surrounded by trees, vines, and clay vessels.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This scene imaginatively portrays a man asking the Lord to identify the one in whom he may believe, as expressed in the supplied Berean Interlinear glosses. The setting and the figures' appearances are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward himself as he speaks with a seated man in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative setting for John 9:37: Jesus tells the man he has seen him and that the one speaking with him is the same person.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man kneels with open hands before Jesus in a warm sunlit stone courtyard, looking toward him with trust and reverence.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the man confessing belief and worshiping Jesus in John 9:38. The courtyard, clothing and appearances are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits on a stone wall and speaks with open hands to listeners on a sunlit village path. One man looks up at him attentively, while another sits in shadow with folded arms and looks away.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses the listeners' contrasting postures and the play of light and shadow to reflect Jesus' words about judgment and the reversal of sight: those not seeing may see, and those seeing may become blind. The setting and individual responses are visual interpretation rather than details specified by the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, four robed Pharisees face Jesus; one gestures toward himself while the others listen.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of John 9:40: Pharisees who are with Jesus hear these things and ask whether they too are blind. The courtyard and gestures are artistic choices. The English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits speaking to four men in a sunlit stone courtyard; one gestures toward his eyes while the others watch.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined conversation illustrates Jesus' words in John 9:41: if they were blind they would not have sin, but since they say they see, their sin remains. The setting, gestures, and expressions are artistic interpretation.
